items.title: Lilly buys Huntington’s drug developer LoQus23 in potentially $725M deal
items.summary: The acquisition hands Lilly what could become a first-of-its-kind treatment designed to inhibit a protein, “MSH3,” that can exacerbate the genetic abnormalities underlying diseases like Huntington's.

items.title: Eli Lilly vs. Vertex Pharmaceuticals: Which Healthcare Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: Eli Lilly's obesity and diabetes sales have surged, while Vertex's cystic fibrosis franchise follows a very different growth path; the valuation gap may settle the debate.

items.title: Pfizer’s CEO Wants AI to “Halve the Time to First Human Study.” Here’s What That Means for Its Pipeline
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPfizer CEO Albert Bourla wants AI to cut the time to a drug’s first human study from four years to two, then halve the time from there to approval. Faster lab work pays off in the 2030s, since nothing Pfizer starts now reaches human trials before generic Eliquis arrives in 2028.
